hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 buyback-and-burn hook with auto-compounding LP fee programs. On sells of the configured "main" token it absorbs the sell at pool execution price from a secondary-token pot (shield, via beforeSwap delta). On buys it spends the pot to buy more main (pump, via nested swap in afterSwap). LP programs auto-harvest fees inside swaps, splitting into compound, buyback, burn, and recipient shares.
